_comment: SAMPLE pack for the demo. The real file is generated from the dbt repo's manifest.json (see data/README.md).

enrollment_headcount.description: Distinct enrolled students per term, as of census date.

expectations.healthy_range: 85-92% of applied headcount by census date

decisions.business_rule: Counted once per student per term, regardless of course count; measured as-of census date, not current date

known_structural_causes: Online-modality programs have a later effective census date than in-person: expect a temporarily lower in-flight rate that closes by their own census
Fall B census trails Fall A by several weeks: cross-term comparisons before Fall B's census will show artificially lower numbers
